ORDER BY B.PRIORITY ASC

SELECT B.APP_ID, B.FTP_ID, B.DOMAIN_ID, B.ORGAN_ID, B.XZQH_ID, B.SERTYPE_ID, B.NAME, B.PATH, B.APP_TYPE, B.IS_SITE, B.IS_DISABLED, B.IS_MOBILE_APP, B.STATUS, B.PRIORITY, B.CREATE_TIME, B.LAST_TIME, B.DEL_FLAG, B.DELETE_TIME, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPARE1, B.SPARE2 , XZQH.NAME as xzqhName FROM BASE_APP B LEFT JOIN BASE_XZQH XZQH on B.XZQH_ID = XZQH.XZQH_ID WHERE APP_ID = #{value}

select.if: SELECT t2.CODE as code FROM BASE_APP t, BASE_XZQH t2 WHERE t.XZQH_ID = t2.XZQH_ID and t.DEL_FLAG = 0 AND t.APP_ID = #{appId}

mapper.select: SELECT B.APP_ID,B. FTP_ID,B. DOMAIN_ID,B. ORGAN_ID,B. XZQH_ID,B. SERTYPE_ID,B. NAME,B. PATH,B. APP_TYPE,B. IS_SITE,B. IS_DISABLED,B. IS_MOBILE_APP,B. STATUS,B. PRIORITY,B. DESCRIPTION , FTP.NAME as ftpName , SERTYPE.NAME as sertypeName , XZQH.NAME as xzqhName, DOMA.NAME as domainName , ORG.NAME as organName FROM BASE_APP B left join BASE_FTP FTP on B.FTP_ID = FTP.FTP_ID left join BASE_SERTYPE SERTYPE on B.SERTYPE_ID = SERTYPE.SERTYPE_ID left join BASE_XZQH XZQH on B.XZQH_ID = XZQH.XZQH_ID left join BASE_DOMAIN DOMA on B.DOMAIN_ID = DOMA.DOMAIN_ID left join BASE_ORGAN ORG on B.ORGAN_ID = ORG.ORGAN_ID WHERE B.APP_ID = #{id}
SELECT NAME as name, APP_ID as cddValue FROM BASE_APP B where B.DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY PRIORITY ASC
